issues: 相邻行用 CSS blur() 各向同性地糊，横向笔画也糊成一团，读不出机械滚筒那种只在滚动方向失焦的景深
滚轮换词时整列只是平移，速度最快的那几帧没有任何运动模糊，和落定时一样锐
三行视窗上下沿是 overflow 硬裁切，远行的字在边上被一刀切掉
#F7F7FA 平底，整个画面只有一行字，没有光也没有颗粒
changes: 相邻行 blur 改为 SVG feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="0 b"，只在纵向失焦，距离曲线（邻行 3px、最远 5px）不变
按滚轮速度叠一层 ≤4px 的纵向运动模糊，换词前快后慢的那 0.55s 有速度感，落定后归 0
离中心越远的行按滚筒曲面压扁（最多 14%），视窗上下沿 26% 柔边渐隐，不再硬切
背景换成柔光渐变 + 极淡强调色余光 + 轻暗角，颗粒放在设计坐标容器外按成片像素取样；强调色统一为 #5b63d3，拍点、缓动、染色系数都不动
issuesEn: Neighboring rows used an isotropic CSS blur(), smearing horizontal strokes too, so it never read as a mechanical drum that defocuses only along the roll direction
During each word change the column simply translated, with no motion blur on the fastest frames, so it looked as sharp in motion as at rest
The top and bottom of the three-row window were hard overflow cuts that sliced through the outer words
A flat #F7F7FA ground held a single line of text, with no light and no grain
changesEn: Neighbor blur now uses an SVG feGaussianBlur with stdDeviation="0 b", so rows defocus only vertically; the distance curve (3px for neighbors, 5px max) is unchanged
A vertical motion blur of up to 4px is layered on in proportion to roll speed, giving each 0.55s fast-then-slow change a sense of speed, and drops to 0 once the word lands
Rows flatten with distance from center to suggest the drum's curvature (up to 14%), and the window's top and bottom fade out over a 26% soft edge instead of cutting hard

The background is now a soft-lit gradient with a faint accent tint and a light vignette; grain sits outside the design-coordinate stage so it samples at output resolution; the accent is unified to #5b63d3, with beats, easing and the tint coefficient unchanged
